notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[h2]We wish you a happy new year! Health, happiness and a great gaming year!
[/h2]

With the start of the new year comes a small update to Split Brain. Here are the details:[list]
[*] [b]Set FOV at 60 by default :[/b] widely used for FPS, should reduce motion sickness for most people. The previous value was 40
[*] [b]Disable "Restart" and "Back to levels" buttons[/b] for 2nd Player on Pause menu
[*] [b]Level 8 :[/b] close gaps on central room stairs
[*] [b]Level 9 : [/b]open door buttons can be used only once (to prevent soft lock)
[*] [b]Level 9 :[/b] small change of start room wall to make it centered
[*] [b]Level 9 :[/b] [spoiler]SFX not triggered if hidden room not discovered fix[/spoiler]
[*] [b]Add Splash screen of us[/b]
[/list]
We are now doing Quality of Life fix and changes. If you have any requests, ideas or bugs in the game, don't hesitate to contact us !

[u]Additional Information[/u]
If you experience any issues after the patch, please reach out to us through the official SPLIT BRAIN [url=https://discord.gg/dgJBntnemK]Discord server.[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.2 : Japanese & Korean translation!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

New week, new update! 

The game has been translated into Japanese and Korean! 

We're still incredibly surprised by how well the game has been received, and we can't thank you enough for all your feedback!

We're continuing to improve the game, and make the experience as enjoyable as possible. Here are the fixes for this update:
[list]
[*][b] Full Japanese & Korean Translation[/b] 🎉
[*] French translation spelling mistakes fix
[*] [b]Tutorial:[/b] Move walls slightly to prevent side walk on "coordination first and second part"
[*] [b]Level 2:[/b] roof collider fix + weird light removal
[*] [b]Level 6:[/b] [spoiler]prevent restart of enemy when first switch after start of chase[/spoiler]
[*][b] Level 8:[/b] glitch through ground and button disappearing fix
[*] [b]Level 8:[/b] change of guide hint after [spoiler]completing labyrinth[/spoiler]
[*] [b]Level 9:[/b] greatly reduce crash (we think its caused by too much lights on screen at the same time)
[*] [b]Level 9:[/b] power activation possible by both players after activating a panel code fix
[*] Load some sounds in background to reduce freeze when [spoiler]first detected by a enemy[/spoiler] or when using sliding doors in level 5
[*] More credits to thanks people who helped us with Translation and level 9 crashes!
[/list]

Don't hesitate to leave your opinion on the steam page, and let us know if you come across anything!

See you soon!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

[h2]A huge thank you to everyone who played Split Brain![/h2]

Whether it's the positive reviews, your feedbacks or your messages of encouragement, the reception of the game has been insane!
The game goes beyond anything we could have imagined, and that's just too cool!

Anyway, in response to the feedback we've received, we've just published an update. 
[h3]Here's what it fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]: German & Simplified Chinese Translation fix
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]: Under 6 minutes fix
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]: Trigger swapping role on restart while not being host fix
[*] [b]UI[/b]: checkmarks change for better resolution sprite
[*] [b]UI[/b]: allow key rebinds in level pause menu
[*] [b]Controls[/b]: Add left mouse click to interact (not changeable)
[*] [spoiler][b]Power[/b]: bigger collider to prevent wall glitches in most cases[/spoiler]
[*] [b]Level 8[/b]: fix pressed button at the end of the labyrinth
[*] [b]Level 8[/b]: fix death sound on right room spikes
[*] [b]Level 9[/b]: Remove useless and misleading levers
[*] [spoiler][b]Level 10[/b]:  more buttons to make it less easy to find the code from luck[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler][b]Level 10[/b]:  deactivation if wrong code even if right code was entered before[/spoiler]
[/list]

Feel free to share the game with your family and friends, and leave us a review if you haven't already!

Thank you again!

Have a nice day/evening escaping Hexarture!

notes.title: Hotfix v1.5
notes.notes:
Hello again everyone!

[b]A bug preventing connection[/b] between players on the new version of the demo[b] has just been corrected.[/b]

Thank you to the people who brought the issue to us so we could correct the issue as quickly as possible!

Sorry for the inconvenience, we hope you will enjoy playing!

Shagar & Drumnam

notes.title: Demo update v1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[b]First update of the Split Brain demo![/b]

Thanks to everyone who tried the demo. 
We're a small team of 2 developers, along with a sound designer and a composer, and we're trying to create an original and fun experience!

Don't hesitate to give us your feedback! We've opened a discussion in the community hub, and we're open to any suggestions for improvement!

You'll find below the list of additions and corrections for this update:
[list]
[*] When the game starts, the general music only starts at 75% of its maximum volume (your ears are important to us).
[*] Music and sound effects balancing revised
[*] Game controls are displayed in the first level, depending on the type of controller used (see images below)
[*] New screen on opening the game, indicating that voice communication is required (see image below)
[*] Level 2: modification of certain elements to make the guide view easier
[*] UI: modification of inventory display when several items are owned
[*] End of levels: removal of invisible walls
[/list]
